channel.title: Pier & Point · MB360 (1200 4th St)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for MB360 (1200 4th St) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · MB360 (1200 4th St): The record had no address
item.description: The record had no address. The Assessor's active lot 8711017 lists the address 1200 4th St. Added as the record's address. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=8711017.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (1200 4th St): The 2013 start is shown as a year, from a May 1, 2013 announcement
item.description: The 2013 start is shown as a year, from a May 1, 2013 announcement. The 177-unit figure comes from the Assessor roll; the architect's page gives different per-block counts. CBS News reported that the March 11, 2014 fire destroyed a 172-unit MB360 building under construction; no source gives that building's address. Source: https://news.theregistrysf.com/bre-starts-construction-on-mission-bay-project/ ; https://ignitionarch.com/project/mb360/ ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8711&lot=017.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (1200 4th St): MB360 (1200 4th St) now uses its Assessor lot lines
item.description: MB360 (1200 4th St) now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8711017.

item.title: Correction · MB360 (1200 4th St): The map notes attributed the two-address premise to…
item.description: The map notes attributed the two-address premise to apartments.com and Zillow listings that are not cited; the two-block development is now cited to Ignition Architecture's project page (Blocks 5/11), and the 701 China Basin St address to the Assessor roll. The summary no longer gives a 2014 Essex acquisition year, the CBS News source title matches its displayed headline, the NAIP photo credit names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. Source: Ignition Architecture, MB 360 (https://ignitionarch.com/project/mb360/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 701 China Basin St (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?block=8710&lot=009); CBS News San Francisco, 2014-05-07 (https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/news/investigators-report-san-francisco-mission-bay-fire-at-mb360-development-was-accidental-likely-caused-by-welding/); USDA NAIP imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Complete · MB360 (1200 4th St): This block (1200 4th St) is completed: the Assessor roll… (~2016)
item.description: This block (1200 4th St) is completed: the Assessor roll (DataSF, parcel 8711017) gives year built 2016 and 177 units, and the architect's project page (Ignition Architecture, undated) gives "Completion 2016" for the development; neither is a report written after the completion, so only the year is shown (~2016). Source: DataSF / San Francisco Office of the Assessor-Recorder; Ignition Architecture (associate design architect on the project).
item.source: DataSF / San Francisco Office of the Assessor-Recorder; Ignition Architecture (associate design architect on the project)

item.title: Under construction · MB360 (1200 4th St): BRE Properties' ~360-unit MB360 development… (~2013)
item.description: BRE Properties' ~360-unit MB360 development (Blocks 5 and 11 of Mission Bay, per the architect's project page) is reported to have begun vertical construction. The Registry, published May 1, 2013, says BRE "has begun vertical construction on its 360-unit MB360 apartment development"; that is an announcement, so the start date itself is not known and only the year is shown. No source read ties the start to this address in particular (~2013). Source: The Registry (Northern California real estate news), 2013-05-01; Ignition Architecture (associate design architect on the project).
